t: Jo Ha Kyu
s: In the Zen Nihon Kendo Renmei Seitei Iai kata Ipponme Mae, we see johakyu in the development and action of the kata. Jo is the peaceful opening and the development of tension and movement until the moment of nuki uchi., at which point, ha occurs. This is the middle, and it starts with cutting of the peace, tense though it might have been, of the beginning.
